meta_title: SOCKS and HTTP Proxy Support | VpnHood!
meta_description: Reach your VpnHood! server through a SOCKS or HTTP proxy when a direct connection to it is blocked. In the VpnHood! apps.
title: Proxies
lead: Reach your server through a SOCKS or HTTP proxy, or relay through one when a direct connection is blocked.
shot_alt: The Proxies screen in the VpnHood! app
platforms: Android, Android TV, iOS, Windows and Linux
how_desc: When a network will not let you reach the server at all, a proxy gives the connection another route in.
when_desc: As a fallback on networks that block the server outright, rather than ones that merely inspect traffic.
cost_desc: SOCKS and HTTP proxies carry their own fingerprint and can be blocked easily by firewalls, so a proxy is a way in rather than a way to go unnoticed. Cloak Mode is the stealth tool.
